szoveg_eredeti:
November 16, 2026 • Published by Mélyne FREUZE

It’s almost time for our annual reunion! SymfonyCon Warsaw 2026 takes place Nov 26-27, featuring 3 tracks of developer talks and community events.

Joining us as a featured speaker is Clément Bertillon, Head of Engineering, SensioLabs, with his upcoming session Giving AI Agents a Durable Memory. We’re so excited to bring this level of expertise to the event!

"How can AI agents retain project context, working conventions and past decisions across sessions and tools? This talk shows how user- and project-level instructions can route agents through a small, indexed and versioned Markdown knowledge base, giving them the operational context they need without turning every prompt into a briefing document. We will also explore the limits of this approach, how it compares with native memory, and when heavier retrieval systems become a better fit."

A special thanks to Smile for sponsoring this 3rd track on November 26th.

Click here to see more talks. The full schedule will be unveiled step-by-step over the coming weeks. Stay tuned!

The official conference hotel offers special preferential rates and flexible conditions for our attendees. Make sure to use our dedicated link to book your room and stay right where the action happens!

Because SymfonyCon isn't just about code, we are happy to confirm that our traditional Community Party will take place on the evening of Thursday, November 26. Get ready for a great night of networking, fun, and connecting with peers!

Ready to contribute? The Hackday on Saturday, November 28 (free and open to all!) will take place at "The Brain Embassy - Czackiego" thanks to the support of Baksla.sh. Bring your laptop and your good mood!

Tickets are available here: Secure your ticket today!
